The Fool.upright: new beginnings, spontaneity, freedom, adventure, potential
The Fool.signification upright: A clean slate invites trust over over-planning. The Fool favors curiosity, play and first steps taken before certainty appears. Follow what feels alive, even if the route is unconventional. Risk exists, but so does bright potential. Travel light: release labels and let experience teach you. In love, bring honesty and openness; in work, prototype and learn in motion. You don’t need every answer to begin—only a sincere yes.
The Fool.signification reversed: Impulses may be steering without awareness. Acting to escape discomfort creates avoidable detours. Slow down enough to sense consequences and safety. Naivety or magical thinking can mask fear of commitment. Revisit your why, set simple guardrails, and step with presence. Beginning wisely is still a beginning.

The Magician.reversed: deception, manipulation, scattered focus, misuse of skills
The Magician.signification upright: Attention is your wand: idea, intention and action align to shape reality. Name the outcome, gather tools, take one focused step. Communicate clearly—ask precisely, promise realistically. This favors skill-building and visible leadership: show, don’t just tell. In love, state needs plainly; in career, ship something real. Momentum compounds when will serves a purpose larger than ego.
The Magician.signification reversed: Charm without integrity backfires. Distraction, half-truths or trying to control others leak power and trust. If energy is scattered, reduce inputs and choose one lever. Audit motives: proving yourself or serving the work? Re-commit to clean methods, simple systems and accountable promises.

The High Priestess.signification upright: Silence becomes a sense organ. Answers surface when you stop pushing and start listening beneath the noise. Dream, journal, notice patterns—what repeats is speaking. Protect your mystery; not everything needs to be posted or solved today. In love, honor boundaries and timing; in work, research privately and move when inner yes and outer signs align.
The High Priestess.signification reversed: You may override intuition to fit expectations, or stay vague to avoid truth. Secrets heal when faced kindly. Name what you know but haven’t admitted. Simplify inputs so your inner signal strengthens. Knowledge used to control is a cage; used to understand, it frees.

The Empress.signification upright: Life blossoms: create, nurture and let things grow in natural rhythm. Pleasure, beauty and care replenish your field. Invest in body, home and art; receive as you give. Collaboration thrives where generosity is real. In relationships, warmth and receptivity deepen bonds; at work, supportive ecosystems multiply results.
The Empress.signification reversed: Clutching too tightly stifles growth. Over-giving to be needed depletes. Step back, breathe, reconnect to cycles of rest and ripening. Allow help, release perfectionism, and trust the soil to do its work.

The Emperor.reversed: tyranny, rigidity, abuse of power, control issues
The Emperor.signification upright: Build frameworks that serve people, not the other way around. Boundaries, strategy and foresight turn chaos into ground. Lead by example; make decisions transparent. Protect the vulnerable, steward resources, and think long-term. Calm order is a kindness.
The Emperor.signification reversed: Grip without trust breaks what it holds. Commanding from fear becomes brittle. Replace micromanagement with clear goals and autonomy. Strength is flexible, accountable and fair.

The Hierophant.signification upright: Meaning flows through lineage, mentors and shared rituals. Learn the form to touch the spirit; transmit wisdom with humility. Good rules protect freedom and foster belonging. Ask, “What is the living principle beneath the custom?”
The Hierophant.signification reversed: When form replaces spirit, systems ossify. Question edicts that shrink compassion. Keep what’s wise, release what’s dead. Make tradition alive by practicing its essence, not its shell.

The Lovers.upright: choice, union, love, duality, important decision
The Lovers.reversed: wrong choice, separation, indecision, inner conflict
The Lovers.signification upright: A values decision disguised as romance or options. Choose where desire, honesty and responsibility coexist. Speak your real yes/no and welcome the same. Alignment beats perfection: shared direction lets details be designed together. Partnership deepens when each remains whole.
The Lovers.signification reversed: Mixed motives and people-pleasing breed friction. A yes to avoid loss is a no to yourself. Pause timelines, clear triangulations, and ask what truth you’re avoiding. If parting serves integrity, grieve cleanly and continue.

The Chariot.upright: mastery of opposing forces, determination, victory
The Chariot.reversed: loss of control, scattered energy, misdirection
The Chariot.signification upright: Two forces pull apart; leadership chooses a shared direction. Define the finish line, set constraints, keep promises to yourself. Small, repeatable wins pull the vehicle forward. Victory is disciplined momentum, not frantic speed.
The Chariot.signification reversed: Wheels spin when goals are vague or pride resists adjustment. If you’re forcing outcomes, loosen the grip and refine the map. Realign metrics with meaning, shorten feedback loops, delegate what drains focus.

Justice.signification upright: Balance is right proportion, not 50/50. Weigh facts, name bias, act transparently. Make amends where needed; credit fairly. Legal or contract matters favor clarity and documentation. Choices now set precedents later.
Justice.signification reversed: Something is off: missing context or unequal stakes. Resist snap judgments; confirm sources. If harsh on yourself, trade punishment for accountability and repair. Advocate for fair process, not just desired outcome.

The Hermit.signification upright: Step back to see truth. Reflection distills noise into knowing. Seek quiet mentors or become your own; let the inner lamp guide measured steps. Share when wisdom ripens.
The Hermit.signification reversed: Hiding isn’t healing. If pride blocks counsel or loneliness hardens, re-enter connection gently. Solitude serves when it keeps you teachable.

Wheel of Fortune.signification upright: The wheel turns: catch the updraft by staying light and responsive. Notice timing, align with what’s moving, and say yes to real openings. What returns offers a new choice this time.
Wheel of Fortune.signification reversed: Clinging recreates what you fear. Break loops by changing one consistent behavior. Accept the lesson, release the script, invite a different scene.

Strength.reversed: weakness, loss of control, aggression, avoidance
Strength.signification upright: Gentle power regulates the storm. Meet force with presence, not panic. Tame, don’t terrorize, what is wild. In love and work, courage plus kindness earns trust.
Strength.signification reversed: Outbursts, collapse or appeasement signal dysregulation. Slow breath, simple boundaries, small brave acts—strength rebuilt from within.

The Hanged Man.signification upright: Suspend action to see differently. Surrender isn’t defeat; it’s a pivot into wisdom. Yielding the old angle reveals an elegant next move.
The Hanged Man.signification reversed: Hanging on without learning wastes time. If pride resists flexibility, choose a tiny surrender. Movement returns when meaning does.

Death.upright: transformation, end of a cycle, rebirth
Death.signification upright: An era completes. Letting go is harvest—you keep the learning, not the form. Ritualize the ending, grieve and clear space. Vitality follows the release.
Death.signification reversed: Avoided endings linger and leak energy. Name what’s over, ask for support, and close gently. Life refills the room you free.

Temperance.signification upright: Mix opposites with care; healing ripens gradually. Calibrate inputs, pace and boundaries. Integrate, don’t oscillate.
Temperance.signification reversed: Too much or too little distorts the recipe. Remove one excess, add one stabilizer, and let time do its part.

The Devil.signification upright: Name the chains—habits, debts, obsessions, toxic bonds. Awareness dissolves glamour and returns consent. Desire isn’t evil; unconscious compulsion is.
The Devil.signification reversed: Keys appear once you stop pretending you’re locked in. Choose one clean break or boundary; freedom expands from there.

The Tower.reversed: resisted change, softened upheaval, gradual restructure
The Tower.signification upright: False structures fall so truth can stand. Though abrupt, the clearing is merciful. After the break, rebuild on honest ground with simpler lines.
The Tower.signification reversed: A quieter correction: learn now or face a louder call later. Remove the loose brick before the wall must go.

The Star.signification upright: Light returns after the storm. Rehydrate spirit through beauty, kindness and rest. Share freely; grace multiplies when given.
The Star.signification reversed: Hope dimmed isn’t hope dead. Reduce noise, seek small wonders, and let trust regrow through tiny, kept promises.

The Moon.reversed: clarity, truths revealed, end of illusion
The Moon.signification upright: Mist and mirrors: move slowly, check projections, follow somatic cues. Not all threats are real, not all signals are false. Dreamwork helps.
The Moon.signification reversed: Fog lifts. Facts surface and inner sense steadies. Proceed with soft confidence and updated maps.

The Sun.signification upright: Warmth, visibility, playful mastery. Share credit, savor results, and create from joy. Your light helps others shine.
The Sun.signification reversed: Polish without depth fades fast. Re-root in authenticity and service; radiance returns.

Judgement.reversed: denial of growth, harsh judgment, guilt
Judgement.signification upright: Awaken to your next assignment. Review honestly, forgive wisely, and answer the call. What’s learned becomes vocation.
Judgement.signification reversed: Stuck in self-blame or refusal. Practice mercy, make amends, and take the one step that proves renewal.

The World.signification upright: Integration achieved. Document, celebrate, and share the pattern you’ve mastered. A doorway opens to the next cycle.
The World.signification reversed: Define “done,” tie the final thread, and let it stand. Closure is a gift to future you.

King of Wands.upright: charismatic leadership, visionary action, creative direction
King of Wands.reversed: impulsive domination, hot-headed rule, ego-driven moves
King of Wands.signification upright: Lead with purpose and fire, not force. Rally allies, set bold aims, remove blockers. Courage plus clarity ignites progress.
King of Wands.signification reversed: Temper the blaze. Listen, share power, and swap pride for partnership. Influence outlasts intimidation.

Queen of Wands.upright: radiant creativity, warm generosity, inspiring presence
Queen of Wands.signification upright: Your warmth sparks rooms and projects. Champion others, play big, and keep joy central to making.
Queen of Wands.signification reversed: Comparison drains the muse. Reclaim play, restore boundaries, and create from self-trust.

Knight of Wands.signification upright: Start fast, learn faster. Pilot daring moves, accept feedback, iterate in motion.
Knight of Wands.signification reversed: Frenzy ≠ progress. Ground the plan, then channel speed into aim.

Page of Wands.upright: creative message, new idea, youthful excitement
Page of Wands.signification upright: First sparks—announce, test, and practice. Curiosity is your teacher now.
Page of Wands.signification reversed: Stay past the first hurdle. Depth makes the idea real.

King of Pentacles.upright: established prosperity, wise stewardship, material leadership
King of Pentacles.signification upright: Build durable value and share it. Invest patiently, safeguard people, and model ethical success.
King of Pentacles.signification reversed: If wealth shrank your world, widen it. Align money with meaning and fairness.

Queen of Pentacles.upright: nurturing abundance, practical care, shared prosperity
Queen of Pentacles.signification upright: Create safety, warmth and flourishing systems. Practical kindness compounds.
Queen of Pentacles.signification reversed: Re-order priorities, curb clutter and revive simple, steady care.

Knight of Pentacles.signification upright: Reliability wins marathons. Keep steady pace, refine process, track small gains.
Knight of Pentacles.signification reversed: Stuck is a cue, not a sentence. Set one clear next task and move.

Page of Pentacles.upright: applied study, new material chance, diligence
Page of Pentacles.signification upright: Lay foundations: learn by doing, ship small, improve. Tangible skills grow security.
Page of Pentacles.signification reversed: Trade hacks for habits. Mastery is repeated care.

King of Cups.upright: emotional mastery, wise compassion, benevolent leadership
King of Cups.reversed: emotional manipulation, calculated coldness, hidden instability
King of Cups.signification upright: Hold steady seas for others. Name feelings, honor needs, mediate fairly. Soft power is strong.
King of Cups.signification reversed: Tactics erode trust. Practice clean asks, boundaries and self-regulation.

Queen of Cups.upright: deep intuition, true empathy, unconditional love
Queen of Cups.signification upright: Offer sanctuary and skilled listening. Empathy with boundaries heals.
Queen of Cups.signification reversed: Refill your own cup. Compassion needs contours to last.

Knight of Cups.reversed: romantic illusions, empty promises, emotional games
Knight of Cups.signification upright: Extend heartfelt offers—art, love, reconciliation. Let sincerity be your style.
Knight of Cups.signification reversed: Test for substance. Choose honesty over performance.

Page of Cups.upright: emotional message, artistic spark, tender opening
Page of Cups.signification upright: A shy door opens—treat feelings gently and express simply.
Page of Cups.signification reversed: Soothe the bruise, not the story. Create in small, safe ways.

King of Swords.reversed: coldness, abuse of power, manipulative intellect
King of Swords.signification upright: Speak truth precisely, decide fairly, and think long-term. Let ethics lead strategy.
King of Swords.signification reversed: Sharp mind needs warm heart. Use power to serve, not dominate.

Queen of Swords.upright: independence, lucidity, candid truth, pragmatic insight
Queen of Swords.signification upright: Name realities cleanly and set respectful boundaries. Hard-won clarity helps others grow.
Queen of Swords.signification reversed: Heal the wound before wielding the word. Kindness sharpens accuracy.

Knight of Swords.signification upright: Advance with courage and a clear brief. Speed plus purpose cuts cleanly.
Knight of Swords.signification reversed: Throttle back, check collateral, and correct aim before charging.

Page of Swords.signification upright: Observe sharply, ask better questions, and communicate responsibly.
Page of Swords.signification reversed: Verify before sharing. Sometimes wisdom is silence.
